graphics_request.subject: NASA Perseverance rover
graphics_request.target_graphic: annotated technical infographic / engineering atlas plate
graphics_request.label_density: full instrument labels plus major subsystem labels
graphics_request.background_policy: decorative Mars background allowed only if it does not obscure rover geometry or labels
graphics_request.logo_policy: avoid NASA logo use unless explicitly allowed by later policy

subject_identity_constraints: The subject must be NASA's Perseverance Mars rover.
The subject must not become Curiosity, Opportunity, Spirit, a generic rover, a lunar rover, or a fictional rover.
The rover must remain an unmanned robotic vehicle.
The rover must retain six wheels, a central chassis, a mast/camera head, and a front robotic arm with an instrument turret.
geometry_constraints: Six wheels must remain visible or logically present.
Wheel arrangement must follow rocker-bogie rover layout.
Mast must rise from the rover body, not from the arm.
Robotic arm must attach to the front/body area.
Instrument turret must be at the end of the robotic arm.
The rover must not gain tank tracks, solar panels, cockpit glass, human seats, or animal-like legs.

instrument_constraints.MOXIE: represented as an internal/body-mounted technology payload, not an external antenna
instrument_constraints.RIMFAX: associated with the lower/rear underside antenna region
instrument_constraints.MEDA: represented as environmental sensors, not a camera cluster

approval_expectations.approved: all required subject, geometry, instrument, label, and style constraints are satisfied with traceable evidence
approval_expectations.needs_review: required subsystem placement is missing, ambiguous, or uncertain
approval_expectations.rejected: subject identity is wrong, forbidden substitutions appear, or geometry is incompatible with Perseverance

inputs.prompt_target: front-left three-quarter clean engineering-manual technical infographic
